keys.beat: Telemachus asks directly for news of Odysseus.
keys.text: 'Tell me, then, about my father... whether he is alive or dead, and whether you saw him with your own eyes.'

keys.beat: Menelaus recounts being trapped in Egypt until Eidothea taught him to seize Proteus.
keys.text: 'A goddess, Idothea, daughter of Proteus the old man of the sea, took pity on me... "Lie in wait for him and catch him; he will tell you about your voyage."'

keys.beat: He and three men hid beneath sealskins and grappled the Old Man of the Sea.
keys.text: 'She had brought four seal skins from the bottom of the sea... she dug four pits for us to lie in, and made us lie down in them, and threw a sealskin over each of us. The stench of the fishy seals was most distressing.'
